opening: The record concerns a conservation workshop tracing a damaged artifact through several rooms. By the time investigators reconstructed the treatment that stabilized the artifact, casual impressions had produced several plausible candidates. The reviewers therefore used only the local rules stated in the surviving record.

scenes.prose: Before comparing names, the panel read the governing notes aloud. For this incident, the board declared the certified restoration lead protocol active; ordinary rank and reputation did not count. The panel fixed one shared status scale for the whole inquiry: open counted as 0; stable counted as 1; waking counted as 2; dormant counted as 3; latent counted as 4; clear counted as 5. The local tally began at 11. In order it used relation, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol statuses with coefficients 7, 11, 3, 5, 2, 13. At each stream, the panel squared the current tally, added that stream's coefficient times its status value, and kept the remainder modulo 97. It made three passes: first in the stated order, then in reverse order with the coefficients reversed, then once more in the stated order with the coefficient list rotated one place left. Without resetting the tally, it repeated that complete three-pass cycle 120 times.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 1

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. When the pairing sheet was recovered, Parker Andersen's apprentice lineage stood at dormant. Even the damaged roster still marked Val Rossi's apprentice lineage as waking. A clock-backed entry listed Tatum Hassan's work interval as clear. The chemical response that followed Indigo Rossi registered as stable. Causal review marked Sawyer Sato's chemical response clear. Door and route checks placed Parker Andersen's workshop room at dormant. Witnesses in the corridor put Val Rossi's workshop room at stable. Reconstruction kept Tatum Hassan's treatment order at open. A close photograph of the token set Indigo Rossi's tool stamp to latent. At final count, Sawyer Sato's tool stamp remained clear.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 2

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. A witness who checked the roster left Indigo Rossi with a latent apprentice lineage. On the sealed worksheet, clerks wrote stable beside Sawyer Sato's apprentice lineage. Clocked entries put Parker Andersen's work interval at open. The sequence sheet showed Val Rossi's work interval as stable. Downstream checks tied Tatum Hassan to a dormant chemical response. A movement sketch marked Indigo Rossi's workshop room as waking. The route ledger tied Sawyer Sato's workshop room to clear. In the ordered log, Parker Andersen's treatment order appeared as stable. The ordered sheet showed Val Rossi's treatment order as clear. Inventory counted Tatum Hassan's tool stamp as stable.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 3

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. In the earlier pairing note, Tatum Hassan carried a open apprentice lineage. After the timesheet review, Indigo Rossi's work interval stayed waking. Reconciled timing notes kept Sawyer Sato's work interval at latent. Instruments tracing Parker Andersen's action left the chemical response latent. When Val Rossi acted, the chemical response came back open. Location review left Tatum Hassan's workshop room open. Sequence notes placed Indigo Rossi's treatment order at dormant. At sequence review, Sawyer Sato's treatment order stayed waking. Token and seal checks left Parker Andersen's tool stamp at waking. The sealed check showed Val Rossi's tool stamp as open.

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. For this incident, the accepted tally was 44. The final definition was strict: the certified restoration lead was the one person whose six-stream tally equaled the accepted tally.
